_note: Which node-only gates a change must run, by path prefix ('**/name' matches that file name anywhere). precheck.mjs unions the entries for every changed file; this is CI's `fast` job, for what you touched. 'always' runs for any change; 'all' is the extra slow gates only `pnpm precheck --all` adds. Not run by default, still runnable by name: gate:no-network, gate:aesthetics and clippy (lint:rust) are pnpm scripts; check:story is a pnpm script and check-cards is not (`node scripts/check-cards.mjs`), both the paused fleet's (nightly `fleet`).
